MAS_decomposition.scope: Identity AP=abs(R-rho)=max(-rho,0)+abs(R-max(rho,0)), since R>=0. This is a CPU decomposition, not a clipped-attribution candidate. Negative density means the remaining signed attribution is negative; it does not by itself prove negative token contributions wrong. Raw scores are retained to detect genuine below-baseline responses hidden by the original clipping/envelope. Methods use their own deletion sets.

DT_raw_logprob_overprediction_at_negativ.formula: sum frozen signed DT scores over actual deleted positions - (raw clean logprob - raw deleted logprob). Positive is conditional deletion-effect overprediction, not a negative causal sign.

target_scope: For each case all methods share the exact author raw prompt, fixed response+EOS, eligible set and original commonFA evaluator. Preserve original FT sink-representation/recursive-generation targets versus existing DT full-response logprob including EOS;internal seeds differ and neither method is changed.

batch_scope.note: Multiple regression examples are separate native B1 workloads. EndpointsB2 are not a two-example minibatch; no throughput claim from these serial cases.

audit_scope: Original formulas, own FP32 density and masks, tie-aware original needle, source/input/receipt/count checks only. No GPU/model/tokenizer replay or FT/framework edits. Audit completion is not a quality-win criterion.
cost_scope: Fixed two-case shard of predeclared NI0-3/MH0-3 regression. One resident model,4normal DT(2control+2candidate),2unchanged Both traces(hops3),168fresh originalFA scores. Every endpoint copy,extra finiteFLA,originalFT identity-valued probe,load/init/compile and failed work remains counted. Timings include different normal/passive diagnostics and are descriptive,not warmed FT0-only speed claims. No historical score substitution,method/layer tuning,negative clipping,sample replacement or stopping based on metric improvement.
